title: Applicability.
bodyText: All claimants filing an action alleging construction defects shall comply with this chapter; provided that this chapter shall not apply to any actions that include claims for personal injury or death.
bodyHtml: [§672E-2  Applicability.]  All claimants filing an action alleging construction defects shall comply with this chapter; provided that this chapter shall not apply to any actions that include claims for personal injury or death. [L 2004, c 119, pt of §2]
